title: Adding carbs via curl.
body: I see that if I add carbs from the `AAPSClient` they are added to the COB in AAPS, but if I do the same via curl or an app like NightGuard they are not added. I was wondering if someone could point me to the code in AAPS where the treatments are filtered, so I can add carbs (and temporary targets) like the AAPSClient does.

comments.body: I think I figured it out, it looks like it cannot be done using the v1 api and have to use v3. Will close, if not the case will reopen.
